sentences.text: Now let's run the complete algorithm.
On our master example, our array is 2, 1, 2, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 0, 2.
We start with low at index 0, mid at index 0, and high at index 9.
Right now, the entire array is unknown.
So we swap the value at mid with the value at high.
Both values are 2, so the array looks exactly the same.
High moves from 9 to 8, and mid stays at 0.
We inspect the same position again.
This time, high is pointing to 0.
Now the value at mid is 0.
Low and mid are both at index 0.
So this is only a self -swap.
Then low moves to 1, and mid moves to 1.
We simply move mid to index 2.
High moves from 7 to 6, but mid stays at index 2.
The value that came from the right is 1.
So we swap index 3 with index 1.
And once again, mid stays at index 4.
The new value at mid is 0.
That is exactly why we did not move mid.
This 0 still needs to be classified.
So we swap index 4 with index 2.
1 is already in the correct middle region.
So we simply move mid forward.
That means the unknown region is empty.
And every time we move a 2 to the right, mid stays until the incoming value is checked.
